description: Bottom-sheet modal for creating or editing a financial priority. Title field (required) + optional multiline Notes field + a primary-gradient CTA. Re-skinned to match the app's standard form-field + CTA treatment (add-transaction / bills forms).

editing.description: when set, sheet is in edit mode and fields prefill

saving.description: PUT/POST in flight → CTA disabled + spinner

onSave.description: validates title required, then POST (create) or PUT (edit)

presentation.keyboardAvoidance: wrap in KeyboardAvoidingView so CTA + notes stay visible while typing

title.label: Title
title.field: glassEffects.glass fill, radius.md, colors.borderGlass border, text colors.text, placeholder colors.textMuted, padding {horizontal spacing.md, vertical spacing.md}

accessibility.note: Sheet focuses the Title field on open; the required field is announced. CTA disabled state is exposed via accessibilityState while saving.

developerNotes: Behavior unchanged from current handleSave (POST for create, PUT for edit, rank preserved on edit / length+1 on create, is_shared:false). Replaces bespoke #1a1a2e sheet + #a855f7/#7c3aed CTA with colors.surface2 + gradients.primaryGradient so it matches every other form sheet. Keep the title-required Alert.
